item.title: linux
item.description: 1. FILE & DIRECTORY NAVIGATION Basics File Basics ls List files and directories ls -l Long listing format (permissions, owner, size, date) ls -a Show hidden files (starting with a dot) ls -lh Human-readable sizes (e.g., 4K, 23M) pwd Print working directory Directory Navigation cd <dir> Change directory to <dir> cd .. Go up one directory level cd ~ Go to home directory cd - Go to previous directory File Management mkdir <dir> Create a new directory rmdir <dir> Remove empty directory 2.
